Senses.Explanation: Forming an understanding by following the words is taking the wording one has heard as the understanding itself. Masters name it when hearers trail an answer, repeat an old judgment, or build a position from someone else’s phrasing. Baizhang describes beings following words into understanding; Dahui rejects that reading of Zhaozhou; Zhongfeng names and answers the same fault, while Chaozong and Guangjiao Guixing turn it against later case handling.
